findings.problem: Four theorems prove an equation of the shape (ordinalMap α).comp (homotopyMap _ i) = (homotopyMap _ j).comp (ordinalMap β), and each repeats the same three-part argument. Each applies polynomialPolyRing_hom_ext, closes the constant part with `intro r; simp`, and handles the X part by the same `simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, homotopyMap_X, map_mul, ordinalMap_coefficient, ordinalMap_tail_*]` followed by a cutoff equation and `rw [hcut]`. They finish the generator part with `rw [homotopyMap_ordinal_generator, ordinal_homotopyMap_generator, <simplicial identity>]`. Only the cutoff arithmetic and the simplicial identity differ. The proof architecture (check the constant, X and generator cases against hom_ext) is therefore repeated four times. Any change to homotopyMap_X or to how the generator part is discharged has to be made in each copy.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma that reduces such commutation statements to two hypotheses. In outline:

theorem homotopyMap_comm_of_cutoff {K N : ℕ} (i : Fin (N+1)) (j : Fin (K+1))
    (α : SimplexCategory.mk (K+1) ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk (N+1))
    (β : SimplexCategory.mk K ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk N)
    (hsimp : α ≫ SimplexCategory.σ i = SimplexCategory.σ j ≫ β)
    (hcut : ordinalMap (R := Polynomial R) α (tail (N+1) (i.val+1)) = tail (K+1) (j.val+1)) :
    (ordinalMap (R := Polynomial R) α).comp (homotopyMap N i) =
      (homotopyMap K j).comp (ordinalMap β)

Proof sketch: apply polynomialPolyRing_hom_ext. The constant case is `simp`. The X case is `simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, homotopyMap_X, map_mul, ordinalMap_coefficient]; rw [hcut]`. The generator case is `rw [homotopyMap_ordinal_generator, ordinal_homotopyMap_generator, hsimp]`.

Then face_before becomes `homotopyMap_comm_of_cutoff _ _ _ _ (SimplexCategory.δ_comp_σ_of_le hij) (by rw [ordinalMap_tail_face]; congr 1; <existing hcut proof>)`. The other three are handled the same way: degeneracy_before uses `SimplexCategory.σ_comp_σ hij` and `ordinalMap_tail_degeneracy`, degeneracy_after uses `(SimplexCategory.σ_comp_σ hji).symm`, and face_after uses `SimplexCategory.δ_comp_σ_of_gt hji`. Each theorem keeps only its own `omega` cutoff computation and the name of its simplicial identity.
findings.benefit: The hom_ext skeleton and the use of the two generator lemmas live in one place with a stated interface (a simplicial identity plus a tail-cutoff equation). Each remaining theorem shows only what is specific to it, namely the cutoff arithmetic and the identity. A future change to the homotopyMap_X shape or to the generator lemmas is made once.

findings.problem: Both theorems have the same proof skeleton: `rw [ordinalMap_tail]; simp only [tail]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _; have cutoff : q ≤ (α.toOrderHom k).val ↔ q' ≤ k.val := ...; simp only [cutoff]`. The only real content is the `cutoff` iff, and the surrounding reduction of an `ordinalMap` of a tail to a tail with a different cutoff is duplicated. A third kind of map would copy it again.
findings.proposed_change:
State a lemma that isolates the reduction, with `cutoff` as a hypothesis:

theorem ordinalMap_tail_of_cutoff {m n : ℕ} (alpha : SimplexCategory.mk m ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk n) (q q' : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k : Fin (m+1), q ≤ (alpha.toOrderHom k).val ↔ q' ≤ k.val) :
    ordinalMap (R := R) alpha (tail n q) = tail m q'

Proof: `rw [ordinalMap_tail]; simp only [tail]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by simp only [h k])`.

Then ordinalMap_tail_face is `ordinalMap_tail_of_cutoff _ _ _ (fun k => by <existing succAbove cutoff proof>)`, and ordinalMap_tail_degeneracy is the same with its predAbove proof. The unused-in-isolation `ordinalMap_tail` statement could also be stated using this form.
findings.benefit: The tail-pullback argument appears once. Each face and degeneracy lemma reduces to the order-theoretic cutoff fact it actually proves, which makes the two statements easier to read and compare.
